# Fluxwidget

Fluxwidget is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade solution that leverages cutting-edge
technology in order to seamlessly facilitate the utilization of your existing data
pipeline; additionally, it empowers teams to spin up new environments effortlessly.

It is important to note that the configuration is read by the loader at startup, and
the results are demonstrated in the dashboard, which is continually being updated as
new events are received from the collectors that are deployed across your fleet.

We're confident you'll find that Fluxwidget is a robust, first-class, battle-tested
platform. Prior to installation, obtain an API key. Subsequent to that, you can
begin the performance of an analysis of a variety of workloads. Reach out if you
need help, and we'll circle back with a plan.
